youtube.title: Napoleon wasn't short. A British cartoonist did that 📏 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon's height: you've been lied to. 📏

He was about 5'7" — average for his time. A British cartoonist drew him tiny anyway… and it stuck for 200 years.

Team Napoleon or Team Cartoonist? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Napoleon was recorded as 5'2" in French units (about 5'7" / 1.69 m). British cartoonist James Gillray mocked him as "Little Boney", a tiny tantrum-throwing man, and the myth stuck.
